title: WhatsApp
intro: Link your own WhatsApp phone. Only you can see its QR code, control it or send from it.
step1: Add a bridge (a name for this phone)
step2: Link the phone: on the phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code
none: You haven't added a WhatsApp bridge yet.
qrStale: This code looks old; press Restart if it doesn't change.
qrWaiting: Waiting for the bridge to show a QR code…
sendsTo: {name}: sends to this phone's own number {number}
availableAfter: Available after the phone is linked.
sent: Sent to {number}. Check WhatsApp on that phone.
warn: Use a dedicated business phone number. Aquarium reads and sends messages as this number, and WhatsApp may block numbers that behave like bots.
othersNote: You only see whether each person's phone is working. Their QR codes, numbers and messages stay private to them.
errLoad: Could not load your WhatsApp bridges.
errQr: Could not get the QR code.
errName: Bridge name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errTest: Could not send the test message.
noHelper: Adding a bridge isn't set up on this server yet. Ask the owner to install the WhatsApp bridge helper.
confirmRebindBody: Rebind {name}? The phone is unlinked and the bridge restarts with a new QR code to scan.
confirmStopBody: Stop {name}? WhatsApp messages stop until you press Restart.
